content.short: Xata is a Fair Liquidity Provisioning protocol providing MEV protection across multiple blockchains.
content.description: Xata, founded in 2021 by Monica Sarbu, is a Fair Liquidity Provisioning protocol designed for multiple blockchains, including Polygon and BNB Chain. It provides an independent solution that reduces MEV without requiring miner bribes or protocol changes. The protocol guarantees it cannot inject new transactions into its outputs or delete any of the ordered transactions, so trading pairs guarded by Xata are not vulnerable to front-running.
